given.note: Ben T. books a haircut with Sam for Sat Dec 5 at 2:00pm. Graph rate-limits the calendar_write's first try with Retry-After 60 seconds, and before its next try Ben calls the visit off, so the call-off's commit wrote this calendar_delete with no providerEventId: the write had made no event yet. The runner holds the delete behind the write, the earlier effect of the same booking, visit and person; the write's second try makes the event, and then the delete runs: the adapter finds Rosie's own event by its key on Sam's link and deletes it, so the called-off visit does not stay on Sam's calendar (arch 05 line 267: 'a call-off or a change of person deletes it'). The booking's date and ids are an illustration.
